sections.theory:
Skills of the high jump

The high jump is made in four different ways.

1 Eastern roll

2 Western roll

3 Straddle roll

4 Fosbury flop

1 Eastern roll

It is also called the scissors style. In it one leg goes forward and the other behind, moving like scissors, and the cross bar is crossed.

2 Western roll

In this style the jump is taken from the same foot on which one lands, and the help of both hands is obtained. The opposite foot of the foot from which the jump is made is brought over the cross bar with a powerful kick. The body is turned over the cross bar in such a way that the face turns towards the pit; landing is done on both feet.
